what_this_is: Real earnings-event shocks for ABT, AEP, AVY, BDX, CLX, COR, CVX, DUK, EOG, ETR, EXC, FFIV, HPQ, HWM, KBH, KEX, NEE, NOC, NSC, NTNX, NXPI, PGR, PSX, RTX, SNX, SPG, TFC, THO, TTMI, TXN, VLO, ZBRA -- anchor ticker(s) HYP-05's reverse search sourced peers for, and which have zero rows in HYP-04's own HYP04_ANCHOR_SHOCKS_2026-08-31.csv because they never qualified under anchor_universe.py's DIFFERENT, own-disclosure-direction rule. See module docstring.
what_this_is_not: This does NOT add ABT, AEP, AVY, BDX, CLX, COR, CVX, DUK, EOG, ETR, EXC, FFIV, HPQ, HWM, KBH, KEX, NEE, NOC, NSC, NTNX, NXPI, PGR, PSX, RTX, SNX, SPG, TFC, THO, TTMI, TXN, VLO, ZBRA to HYP-04's anchor universe, does not touch HYP04_ANCHOR_EVENT_CALENDAR_*.csv or HYP04_ANCHOR_SHOCKS_2026-08-31.csv (neither read nor writable by this module), and moves no HYP-04 gate condition. It is HYP-05-side evidence only.

rules.dedup_rule: one anchor event per (anchor_ticker, release_date); the earliest ACCEPTANCE wins, ties broken on accession -- the identical rule anchor_calendar.DEDUP_RULE states, applied here directly to unwrapped CandidateEvents because there is no membership interval to place them into

lineage_check.COR: Elanco's relationship is as_of 2025-02-25. Cencora, Inc., CIK 0001140859, RENAMED (not re-incorporated) from 'AmerisourceBergen Corp' in 2023 -- 2025 is inside the renamed era.
lineage_check.CVX: Tidewater's relationship is as_of 2008-05-30. Chevron Corp, CIK 0000093410, renamed from 'ChevronTexaco Corp' (the 2001 Chevron/Texaco merger's continuing entity) well before 2008 -- inside the renamed era.

lineage_check.EOG: CKX Lands' relationship is as_of 2015-03-23/2016-03-29. EOG Resources Inc, CIK 0000821189, RENAMED from 'Enron Oil & Gas Co' in 1999 (a spinoff/rename, not a merger) -- 2015-2016 is decades inside the renamed era.
lineage_check.ETR: CKX Lands' relationship is as_of 2015-03-23. Entergy Corp /DE/, CIK 0000065984, former name differs only by state-of-incorporation suffix ('/FL/' vs '/DE/') -- one continuous filer.

session_index.why_wider: The authoritative instance is built with no `start`, so its first session is a package default rather than a data limit. HYP-04's anchor calendar reaches earlier, and dropping those events would let data availability decide membership.

every_event_has_a_row: All candidate events appear, computed or denied -- same discipline as make_anchor_shocks.py.
